messages:
emily: quick sync - updated the rollout-metadata RFC to include 'wildcard scope' and a compact resolve audit. want quick thumbs.

clare: nice. wildcard helps cardinality. how do we ensure runtime still O(1)?

emily: runtime stays O(1) by resolving wildcards at deploy-time into an effective pointer cache. control-plane expands wildcards and computes canonical_hash -> pointer mapping.

miguel: sounds good. collision strategy for canonical_hash?

emily: use xxh64 with a versioned salt; on collision control-plane falls back to human-key compare and logs an alert.

clare: migration? converting flat pins -> scoped with phase=preview then flip to live per-tenant seems safest.

miguel: +1. add a limit per-tenant and a quota error so UI can suggest wildcarding.

opsbot: @emily - TODO created: rollout.wildcard-quota owners=platform retention=30d.

emily: will add checklist to PR: hash spec, migration CLI, control-plane expand+cache, runtime shim ok_until, audit event <200B. aiming for dogfood next sprint.

clare: thanks, will review. end thread.
